name: romeo-vs-shakespeare
beat: royal orchestral strings and harpsichord stabs

Romeo.look: Character sheet, front view and three-quarter view, of Romeo as an adult K-pop idol (fictional, not resembling any real person): early 20s, silver-pink styled hair, a Renaissance velvet doublet in black and magenta reworked as an idol stage outfit, a small glass poison-vial pendant. Plain grey background.
voice: solo young male rapper with a high, bright, light tenor voice
Romeo.performs: A young K-pop idol rapper raps energetically to the camera with attitude, head bobbing to the beat, expressive hand gestures, blinking naturally.

Shakespeare.look: Character sheet, front view and three-quarter view, of an old Elizabethan playwright in the style of the well-known 1600s portraits of Shakespeare: balding with long side hair, moustache and small beard, white ruff collar, dark doublet, modern studio headphones around his neck. Not resembling any real person or actor. Plain grey background.
voice: solo old man rapper with a very deep, low, gravelly bass voice
Shakespeare.performs: An old theatrical man raps to the camera with slow, heavy, menacing attitude and smug expressions, small head nods to the beat, blinking naturally.

frameStyle: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic cinematic music-video frame, K-pop music-video lighting with magenta and teal accents and haze, everyone is an adult. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
